title: PQC-TLS Demo dashboard event
description: Every stage the dashboard renders is one event with this fixed shape. Both Pis (server + client) emit these. This schema is locked early; everything downstream (app/, capture/, replay/, dashboard/) depends on it. See PROJECT_PLAN.md section 7.

stage.description: Which pipeline stage produced this event. Ordered roughly by handshake/message flow.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds with fractional milliseconds, when the artifact was produced.

artifact_type.description: Human/machine label for what artifact_bytes_b64 holds (e.g. 'ml_kem_768_public_key', 'ml_kem_768_ciphertext', 'ml_dsa_65_signature', 'aead_ciphertext', 'aead_tag', 'shared_secret_fingerprint', 'plaintext', 'wire_frame').

artifact_bytes_b64.description: The raw artifact, base64-encoded. May be omitted when the artifact is not byte-extractable (e.g. a derived secret exposed only as a fingerprint — see human_readable / PROJECT_PLAN.md section 13).

human_readable.description: A short string the dashboard shows verbatim: a hex preview, a fingerprint, decoded plaintext, or an explanatory note.

size_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the underlying artifact (NOT of the base64 string). For non-extractable artifacts, the real size if known, else 0.

algorithm.description: Optional FIPS algorithm name this stage exercised (e.g. 'ML-KEM-768', 'ML-DSA-65', 'X25519MLKEM768', 'AES-256-GCM').

seq.description: Optional monotonically increasing sequence number within a single run, for stable replay ordering.

note.description: Optional free-form annotation (e.g. 'shared secret not extractable from TLS; showing SHA-256 fingerprint').
